consent.title: Your data, your choice
consent.collect: Your phone number, your profile, the money entries you add, your chats with Saathi and scam messages you check. Voice recordings are turned into text and then deleted.
consent.purpose: To give you money guidance, find schemes for you, and keep you safe from scams. Saathi's replies are written with Google's Gemini AI, which receives your chats and profile details for that.
consent.retention: Until you delete it. You can delete your chats, memories or your whole account any time.
consent.rights: You can see, correct, download or delete your data, and raise a complaint.

unrealistic_returns.title: Promises unrealistic returns
unrealistic_returns.text: Offers like 'Earn ₹50,000 daily' are usually fake. Real jobs and investments don't pay like this.

asks_personal_info.title: Asks for personal or payment information
asks_personal_info.text: Banks and government offices never ask for your OTP, PIN, CVV or password by message or call.

urgency.title: Uses urgency to pressure you
urgency.text: Scammers rush you so you don't stop to think or check with someone.

suspicious_link.title: Contains a suspicious link
suspicious_link.text: The link hides where it really goes or is not secure. Don't open it.

fake_brand_link.title: Link pretends to be a trusted brand
fake_brand_link.text: The website name looks like a bank or government site but it is not the official one.

install_app.title: Asks you to install an unknown app
install_app.text: Apps sent through messages can read your OTPs and steal money. Install apps only from the Play Store or App Store.

advance_fee.title: Asks for money before giving a loan or prize
advance_fee.text: Genuine lenders and prizes don't ask you to pay a fee first.

account_threat.title: Threatens to block your account
account_threat.text: Banks don't block accounts through random messages. Check directly with your bank branch or official app.

fake_prize.title: Says you won a prize you never entered for
fake_prize.text: You can't win a lottery or draw you never joined.

impersonation.title: Pretends to be a government office or bank
impersonation.text: Government offices never threaten arrest or ask for money on calls or chats. 'Digital arrest' is not real.

fake_job.title: Typical fake job/task scam
fake_job.text: Paying you for likes or small tasks is a trap. Later they ask you to 'invest' to unlock bigger payouts.

remote_access.title: Asks for remote access to your phone
remote_access.text: Screen-sharing apps let strangers see and control your phone, including your bank app.

investment_tips.title: Unregistered investment tips
investment_tips.text: Tip groups promising sure profits are usually not SEBI-registered and often vanish with your money.

upi_trick.title: Trick to make you send money by UPI
upi_trick.text: You never need to scan a QR code or enter your UPI PIN to receive money.

unknown_number.title: Pushes you to contact an unknown number
unknown_number.text: Moving the chat to a personal number is how scammers avoid official checks.
